authorityPolicy.sameTier: Complete RB/WR evidence may break a tie only when expert tier, rank distance, Mamba gap, and source-value gap are all within the stage budget.
authorityPolicy.oneTier: GUARDED_REVIEW only; requires current ADP availability, HIGH complete evidence, completed starter foundation, neutral roster context, bounded rank/Mamba/value gaps, and poor survival.

reachBudget.waitForPrice: Known likely survival defeats take-now authority
reachBudget.prohibitedReach: Multi-tier, missing tier/evidence/identity, unsupported position, or exceeded stage budget

rosterStateRules.openStarters: No one-tier review while configured starter capacity remains.
rosterStateRules.healthyFoundation: Late/bench one-tier review may be considered subject to every other guardrail.
rosterStateRules.replaceableBench: Only complete evidence may identify low optionality.

adpComparison.withCurrentAdp: One-tier GUARDED_REVIEW can be considered only if all other constraints pass.
adpComparison.withoutCurrentAdp: Authority is reduced to same-tier-only; expert rank is context and never substituted for ADP.

proposed4_3_20Authority.scope: Highest Upside evidence plus late/bench same-tier Best Pick tie-breaking only
proposed4_3_20Authority.early: No Best Pick authority; alignment may increase explanation confidence only.
proposed4_3_20Authority.middle: No one-tier authority; same-tier evidence only after ordinary value and roster checks.
proposed4_3_20Authority.late: Complete RB/WR evidence may break a bounded same-tier tie; one-tier remains GUARDED_REVIEW, not automatic selection.
proposed4_3_20Authority.bench: Same late rule; preserve valuable RB depth and require replaceable-floor context.
proposed4_3_20Authority.survival: WAIT_FOR_PRICE whenever existing timing output says likely to survive.
proposed4_3_20Authority.missingData: Fail closed; current ADP missing forces same-tier-only.
proposed4_3_20Authority.rollback: One feature flag disables all authority and returns exact Jōnin ordering.
